about: People named in hearing evidence (the named-people prompt rule). Twenty Ask questions, ten on the Robodebt Royal Commission and ten on the NSW Healthcare Funding inquiry, worded to surface people named in the evidence. For scripts/research_eval.mjs --questions. Pass: reading each answer in full, no person is named outside quotation marks. The report's named-people count helps the reader; a count of 0 is not proof.
